pattern: Labelled group of WAI-ARIA APG Spinbutton segments (one text input per unit) with no popup; each segment exposes its unit value and a localized value text.

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
"true" while the picker is disabled; absent otherwise
Localized unit name (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds)
Number in the segment; removed when empty
Number with the long localized unit (for example "30 minutes"); removed when empty
23 for hours and 59 for minutes and seconds below a larger unit; for the largest segment, max in that unit (rounded down) or the digit limit (for example 999)
"true" only while an error message is shown

keyboard.action: Enters digits (other characters are removed); advances when the segment is full, or, below the largest unit, when no second digit could be valid (for example 7 minutes), padding to two digits.
Pads a single digit below the largest unit and advances to the next segment.

Changes the total by one unit of the segment and carries into the other units; the smallest segment moves by step, snapping to the step grid first. Clamped to [min or 0, max or the digit limit]; an empty entry starts from zero.
Sets the segment to 0 / its aria-valuemax.

keyboard.context: Caret at the segment edge, or text selected
keyboard.action: Previous or next unit in reading order (mirrored in RTL).
Moves through the segments, then out of the control.

focus: Each segment is a tab stop; focusing one selects its text. The group shows the focus indicator (border in color-focus-ring plus a 1px ring) while any segment is focused, and the focused segment uses the selected colors with a focus-ring outline on :focus-visible. Clicking the label focuses the first segment. Rebuilding the segments (fields, locale, or max change) keeps focus on the same unit.
notes: The label is a <label> associated through aria-labelledby because a group is not labelable; clicking it focuses the first segment unless disabled.
The visible unit text is aria-hidden because each segment's name and aria-valuetext already carry the unit.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; each segment carries the native required state.
Errors appear after the first blur of the whole control by default, so moving between segments does not trigger messages.
Validation messages format durations in the locale with short units (for example 'Enter a duration of 1 hr, 30 min or more.').
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior (spinbutton names, aria-valuetext on step) has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
aria-valuemin is always 0 per segment; min is enforced by stepping and validation, not exposed on the segments.
